parent_objective: audit M1538 source-expanded repeat before any materialization or self-ID claim
blocked_by: M1538 source-expanded repeat is positive overall but T5 history-positive target sides remain zero

public_gates: M1539 must audit source-diversity pass and T5 history-positive absence separately
M1539 must audit wrong-history donor-plus-hidden donor-stream delayed-hidden and reset/zero controls separately
M1539 must decide whether candidate materialization remains blocked
M1539 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim level3 self-identification from M1538 alone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1538 source-expanded history-intervention repeat and chooses the next evidence route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats T4/source-expanded positives as terminal-boundary evidence
stop if audit ignores donor response/action stream weakness
stop if audit ignores T5 history-positive absence
stop if audit routes directly to training or promotion
fallback_plan: route to terminal-boundary task generation or pair repair if T5 absence blocks materialization
route to materialization design only if audit bounds the claim scope and excludes unsupported T5 claims
route to branch synthesis if source expansion creates conflicting evidence

admission_evidence: M1538 produced source-expanded measured-mining and history-intervention repeat artifacts
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up design or synthesis manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1539 must audit whether positives require accumulated history or are still explainable by current response/action controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If T5 positives are absent or donor stream is weak, route to pair repair or bounded materialization design rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1538 is source-expanded and history-positive overall, but its T5 absence and donor-stream weakness must be audited before any materialization route.
success_criteria: audit reports source-diversity T5 history-positive control-dominance and guardrail metrics
audit explicitly decides whether materialization remains blocked
audit routes to one follow-up task-generation pair-repair materialization-design or synthesis manifest
training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit ignores donor response/action stream weakness
audit routes directly to training promotion or private holdout
audit claims level3 self-identification from M1538 alone
decision_rule: M1539 passes if it audits M1538 and chooses the next route without overclaiming or materializing candidates.
